title: An out-of-process iframe attaches, is readable frame-scoped, and detaches cleanly
description: Under site isolation a cross-origin iframe runs out-of-process; the driver must still enumerate it, evaluate inside it, and observe the frame tree shrink after removal.

steps.expression: var f = document.createElement('iframe'); f.src = 'http://localhost:' + location.port + '/v0_4/frames/child?tag=oopif'; f.id = 'xo'; f.onload = function () { window.__xo_loaded = true; }; document.getElementById('slot').appendChild(f); 'inserted'
